##: The DLLs the assistant needs beside its program on Windows (issue #773): sherpa-onnx as a DLL instead of
static libraries built against the static C runtime. Both DLLs carry their own C runtime (k2-fsa's
`shared-MT` build), so no Visual C++ runtime is needed. `sherpa_onnx` must match sherpa-onnx-sys in
Cargo.lock; packaging/assistant_runtime.py refuses a mismatch. On an update of sherpa-onnx: new version,
archive hash and DLL hashes here, the rest follows.
